newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow on Monday, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Inquiry fair, demand light.
Sales confirmed on 2,600 slaughter steers and 3,900 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 58,000 head confirmed including 10,100 head contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1325 lbs 64.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 64.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1090 lb heifers and heiferettes 62.50.
Confirmed - 6,500 last week - 100 last year - none
Wk to date - 58,000 last week - 100 last year - 30,400
